description: Defines data models for the Fitness TV app, including Workout, Badge, Profile, Goal, and ProgressEntry classes used to represent various entities within the app.

classes.name: Workout
classes.description: Represents a workout session with attributes like id, title, category, duration, intensity, video and thumbnail URLs, and estimated calories burned.

classes.name: Badge
classes.description: Represents a badge earned by the user, including id, name, description, and icon.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Contains user profile information such as name, age, weight, height, and fitness goals.

classes.name: Goal
classes.description: Defines user fitness goals including weekly workouts and target calories per week.

classes.name: ProgressEntry
classes.description: Records daily progress metrics such as date, calories burned, and minutes exercised.
